rubric.label: ISOLATED
rubric.definition: Effect demonstrated only at its originating processing stage.

rubric.label: ADJACENT_PROPAGATION
rubric.definition: Effect demonstrably propagates from its origin into one downstream processing stage.

rubric.label: MULTISTAGE_PROPAGATION
rubric.definition: Effect demonstrably persists across multiple downstream processing stages, but no consequential terminal interpretation, security, or decision endpoint is demonstrated.

rubric.label: CONSEQUENTIAL_ENDPOINT
rubric.definition: Effect demonstrably propagates across processing stages and reaches a consequential downstream interpretation, security, or decision endpoint.
